codex.name: exec_command
codex.autoPermissionInstructions: For exec_command, request full-access execution with sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated" and include a concise justification. Keep sandbox_permissions at "use_default" or omit it to stay sandboxed. Put only the attached secret IDs this exact command needs in secrets. Secret provisioning is reviewed separately and does not change the sandbox; secrets and escalation may be used independently or together.

codex.name: apply_patch
codex.autoPermissionInstructions: For apply_patch, request reviewed Full access for this patch with sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated" and a concise justification. Protected and outside-workspace paths are also reviewed automatically without the flag. Approval elevates only this call; Read only and Workspace write never elevate.
